Lemma
[Uniform upper bound for $\widetilde L_i$ on compact sets] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0157, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0158, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0159 ↗ def:chow-iv-type-a-singular-solution 1. ch30:30.4\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

Assume uniformly that $|\Rm _{g_i}|\leq M(\omega _i-t)^{-r}$, where $r\in [1,3/2)$, and fix $t_0\in (\alpha _\infty ,\omega _\infty )$. If $r>1$, then for sufficiently large $i$, \[ \begin{split} \widetilde L_i(q,t)\leq {}& 2\exp \! \left(\frac{2nM}{r-1} \left(\frac{\omega _\infty -t}{2}\right)^{-(r-1)}\right) \sqrt{\omega _\infty -\alpha _\infty } \frac{d_{g_\infty (t_0)}(q,p_\infty )^2}{\omega _\infty -t}\\ & +\frac{n^2M}{3/2-r}(\omega _\infty -t)^{3/2-r}. \end{split} \] If $r=1$, the exponential factor is replaced by $2(2(\omega _\infty -t_0)/(\omega _\infty -t))^{2nM}$, and the final term may be taken to be $2n^2M(\omega _\infty -t)^{1/2}$.
